changelog:
- Initial release of the mobility-quote skill.
- Provides global route options, fare estimates, ETA, and deeplinks to open supported ride apps.
- Queries the KLO Mobility A2A agent for multimodal providers (public transit, taxi-like, walking).
- Outputs structured results with cheapest quote, all available options, and route launcher links.
- Not a booking or payment agent; focuses on discovery and price/ETA quotes.
summary: Get mobility route options worldwide — fare estimates, ETA, and a one-tap deeplink to open the ride. Queries the KLO Mobility A2A agent.
